newsitem.title: CROATIA: Volume up, rates stable at Croatia bank bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Volume up, rates stable at Croatia bank bill sale.

text.p: Bill volume rose to 275 million kuna at the Croatian central bank weekly auction on Wednesday from 167.5 million as most investors renewed previous subscriptions upon expiry, the bank said.
The 35-, 91- and 182-day rates were stable at 7.0, 8.5 and 9.5 percent, respectively.

Participation at primary sales of the central bank paper is limited to Croatia's banking sector, which uses these bills as colateral for Lombard loans, granted at 9.5 percent for a total of 12 working days each month.
Outstanding Lombard loans more than doubled to 96 million kuna this morning from 40.5 million at the end of Tuesday. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075
